name: Old Yanshi
title: Old Yanshi
summary: The remains of the original Yanshi destroyed in the Atonement event: scorched obsidian/volcanic ground, broken halls and a central rock hall, the Destroyed Statue of a Reedshark, Beldin's octagon pavilion and the Harbinger tunnels' generators.

landmarks.name: Destroyed Statue of a Reedshark
landmarks.note: Spawn wcid 21282 (size not in the kit).

shots.standingOrder: Fly due north at 5.5 m/s 32 m above the ruins of Old Yanshi with the gimbal tracking the central rock hall until it passes beneath; stay 25 m above every tree and ruin.
shots.notes: Over the remains of the original town destroyed in the Atonement: obsidian/volcanic ground, broken halls and the central rock hall; the gimbal tracks the rock hall down to vertical as it passes beneath; noon sun behind the lens.
